about: Scoring rubric for slideshows, 0-2 per criterion. Source of truth: docs/SLIDESHOW_LOOP.md (the loop revises both).

criteria.name: One clear job
criteria.ask: Does it do exactly one job: share, save, comment or identity?

criteria.name: Hook at a glance
criteria.ask: Slide 1 readable in 1.5 s, about 14 words or fewer, a number or a universal habit?

criteria.name: Proven structure
criteria.ask: Same structure as a reference with 100K+ likes?

criteria.name: Swipe pull
criteria.ask: Does slide 1 promise something only later slides pay off?

criteria.name: Every slide earns it
criteria.ask: No filler; save decks have real content on every slide?

criteria.name: App placement
criteria.ask: Reach decks: no app. Carrier decks: app as confession, method or punchline, never the hook?

criteria.name: Looks native
criteria.ask: Font, size and position match the reference; reads as a person, not a brand?

criteria.name: Image honesty
criteria.ask: Own, public-domain, CC or renders; AI only for dim scenes, and labelled?

criteria.name: Comment pull
criteria.ask: Something people want to answer: a closing question where the reference has one, 'same' bait, a count-your-score list, or a sound people react to?

criteria.name: Truth
criteria.ask: Every first-person claim true, or listed in the check list?
